models.quantization: community post-training onnx/model_q4.onnx plus exact model_q4.onnx_data
models.pooling: full sentence_embedding output, including mask-mean pooling, both Dense projections and normalization; never substitute last_hidden_state

data.collection: Exactly60 original document fields,248 train/cal queries and32 already frozen mixed development queries. No check scoring and no acceptance file import/read/search. Labels/IDs/annotator evidence are never prefixed to source text. Input case is preserved.
data.tokenizer: Before native collection compare full IDs and attention against Rust tokenizers0.22.2 for all340 prefixed originals, using explicit UTF8 IPC. Persist hashes and direct comparison counts. Source tokenizer files are model-specific; do not share or swap them.
data.encoding: Current locked text dependencies, Node24.14, ORT1.21 CPU intra2/inter1, arena default. Effective collection token cap512, no truncation; count full original prefixed tokens first, above512 is unknown. Official long-context maxima remain metadata, not a tested promise. Physical batch1; one model worker at a time, no vector prefills. Reverse first5 docs/first5 queries for order stability.
data.identity: Freeze collector/native worker/helper/tokenizer/model/data/runtime hashes before collection; strict per-model fingerprint and384/768 dimensions. Validate finite L2 vectors, original text hashes/ordinals/tokens; record starts, cold/index/new-query and repeats separately. PID+creation observed exit/OS absence and unknown fence; no restart on observation timeout.

developmentSelection.fitSplit: train only; calibration/mixed are read only after a selected train point is frozen
developmentSelection.minimumCosines: Fixed201-point grid -1.00 through1.00 inclusive, step.01. This calibrates each previously untested model; no gap/z/background/learned-head grid.
developmentSelection.perField: Filter complete structured IDs before global eligibleK; chooseK before strong exemption/cutoff, no refill. Preserve authenticated same-field phrase/all effective terms/all complete IDs. Each weak lexical/metadata field independently uses its own fixed highest original96/16 coarse window and the same selected cosine cutoff, no sibling borrowing or alternate-window retry. No extra verifier.
developmentSelection.fixedCorpusReplay: Require original90a complete captures and source-before/after bindings. Only60 original fields<=96 and <=1 lexical hit/query for248 replay; mixed capture is32 complete with0 hits. Preserve original lexical/semantic ordering and90a RRF before limit; never count unknown as true negative.
developmentSelection.trainFloors: Complete coverage, Chinese/English same-language Recall@5>=.90, both cross-language directions>=.85, overall positive MRR>=.75, pureOOD conservative any-result FPR<=.05 in each original query language bucket separately, exact/correction IDs preserved. Missing facts are separate diagnostics, not unrelated negatives.
developmentSelection.select: Among passing train points chooseK1 first (fewer source projections); then lowest worst-language OOD upper bound, highest overall train MRR, highest train Recall@5, then lowest cutoff. If none pass, RED_NO_TRAIN_POINT; no fallback threshold or alternate method. Freeze the single selected point per model before calibration/mixed evaluation; do not change it after failure.
developmentSelection.validate: Apply the frozen point unchanged to62 calibration records and32 mixed development records. Calibration retains the same train floors and original Chinese/English OOD denominators. Mixed: Recall@5>=.90 overall, each document-language group>=.85, MRR>=.75, pureOOD upper bound<=.05, complete coverage. If no train point, later splits explicitly NOT_EVALUATED with original denominators.

reporting.quality: Raw top1/4/5 by direction, selected admitted quality, lexical/semantic/weak/strong roles, unsupported diagnostics, original language denominators including mixed queries with Han, unknown and partials, logical projection counts. Existing development is not independent evidence.
reporting.resources: Raw graph/external weights/tokenizer/config/dependencies/scripts/Node/package are separate. Current worker RSS and lifetime peak are not whole-desktop incremental RAM or causally paired comparisons. NoMRL dimensions are chosen in this batch; output shortening would not shrink weights.
reporting.provenance: IBM model card Apache2 does not silently resolve311M Gemma-derived tokenizer terms. EmbeddingGemma community export inherits Gemma terms and is distinct from Google QAT. Original ggml-org QAT Q4_0 GGUF lacking both Dense heads is excluded from full-pipeline quality evaluation.
reporting.fullGoal: No production/default/version/automatic change or gate closure. Full independent quality must use a newly authored full-language holdout after final method freeze; v6 is not executed but partially exposed and cannot be blind final evidence. Actual search/recovery/explicit-memory consumers,1000-fragment500ms, lifecycle/privacy/CLI/UI207 and new packages remain required before commit/push.
